from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os

import pandas as pd

from shopsphere.common import (
    DATA_DIR, OUT_DATA, OUT_OUTPUTS, PLAN_REPORTS as OUT_REPORTS,
    ROLLING_MODELS, ensure_dirs, read_budget, resolve_as_of,
)

OBJECTIVES = {
    "incremental_revenue": "Expected incremental revenue",
    "net_value": "Expected net margin after incentive",
    "roi": "Expected net return per dollar of incentive",
    "propensity": "Purchase probability",
}


def load_scores() -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "offer_candidate_scores.parquet"))


def default_week_start() -> pd.Timestamp:
    budget = read_budget()
    weeks = pd.to_datetime(budget["week_start"]).dropna().sort_values().unique()
    if not len(weeks):
        return pd.Timestamp(resolve_as_of(None, DATA_DIR)) + pd.Timedelta(days=7)
    as_of = pd.Timestamp(resolve_as_of(None, DATA_DIR))
    upcoming = [w for w in weeks if pd.Timestamp(w) >= as_of]
    return pd.Timestamp(upcoming[0] if upcoming else weeks[-1])


def budget_for(week_start, country: str) -> float:
    budget = read_budget()
    week = pd.Timestamp(week_start)
    row = budget[(budget["week_start"] == week) & (budget["country"] == country)]
    if len(row):
        return float(row["retention_budget_usd"].iloc[0])
    nearest = budget[budget["country"] == country]
    if len(nearest):
        nearest = nearest.assign(_gap=(nearest["week_start"] - week).abs())
        return float(nearest.sort_values("_gap")["retention_budget_usd"].iloc[0])
    return float(budget["retention_budget_usd"].mean())


def seasonality_factor(week_start, country: str, horizon_days: int = 6) -> tuple[float, str]:
    path = os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "analytics_seasonality_month.csv")
    week = pd.Timestamp(week_start)
    end = week + pd.Timedelta(days=horizon_days)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return 1.0, "seasonality unavailable; using 1.00x"
    season = pd.read_csv(path)
    months = sorted({d.month for d in pd.date_range(week, end, freq="D")})
    rows = season[
        (season["country"] == country) & (season["month_num"].isin(months))
    ]
    values = rows["revenue_index_vs_year_mean"].dropna()
    if values.empty:
        return 1.0, "no same-month history; using 1.00x"
    factor = float(values.median())
    factor = max(0.75, min(1.35, factor))
    names = ", ".join(pd.Timestamp(2024, m, 1).strftime("%b") for m in months)
    return factor, f"{names} seasonal demand index {factor:.2f}x (week to week+6)"


def build_plan(
    week_start,
    country: str,
    budget_usd: float | None = None,
    objective: str = "incremental_revenue",
    min_uplift: float = 0.0,
    min_net_value: float | None = 0.0,
    max_contacts: int | None = None,
    cooldown_days: int = 14,
    scores: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict]:
    if objective not in OBJECTIVES:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown objective {objective!r}")
    if scores is None:
        scores = load_scores()
    week = pd.Timestamp(week_start)
    df = scores[scores["cust_country"] == country].copy()
    seasonal_factor, seasonal_note = seasonality_factor(week, country)
    df["seasonal_factor"] = seasonal_factor
    df["expected_incremental_revenue"] *= seasonal_factor
    df["expected_incremental_margin"] *= seasonal_factor
    df["expected_net_value"] = df["expected_incremental_margin"] - df["offer_cost"]
    df["roi"] = (
        df["expected_net_value"] / df["offer_cost"].replace(0, pd.NA)
    )
    df["days_since_last_contact"] = (
        (week - pd.to_datetime(df["last_contact_date"])).dt.days.fillna(9999)
    )
    df = df[df["days_since_last_contact"] >= cooldown_days].copy()
    df = df[df["uplift"] >= min_uplift].copy()
    df = df[df["expected_incremental_revenue"] > 0].copy()
    if min_net_value is not None:
        df = df[df["expected_net_value"] >= min_net_value].copy()
    if objective == "roi":
        df = df[(df["expected_net_value"] > 0) & (df["offer_cost"] > 0)].copy()
    elif objective == "net_value":
        df = df[df["expected_net_value"] > 0].copy()

    if objective in ("incremental_revenue", "propensity"):
        df["priority_score"] = df["expected_incremental_revenue"]
    elif objective == "net_value":
        df["priority_score"] = df["expected_net_value"]
    else:
        df["priority_score"] = df["roi"]

    df = df.sort_values(["priority_score", "expected_net_value"], ascending=False)
    df = df.drop_duplicates("sample_ref", keep="first").copy()
    df = df.sort_values(["priority_score", "expected_net_value"], ascending=False)

    budget = float(budget_usd) if budget_usd is not None else budget_for(week, country)
    cumulative = df["offer_cost"].cumsum()
    df = df[cumulative <= budget].copy()
    if max_contacts is not None:
        df = df.head(int(max_contacts)).copy()

    df.insert(0, "week_start", week.date().isoformat())
    df.insert(1, "country", country)
    df["priority_rank"] = range(1, len(df) + 1)

    spend = float(df["offer_cost"].sum())
    inc_rev = float(df["expected_incremental_revenue"].sum())
    inc_margin = float(df["expected_incremental_margin"].sum())
    net = float(df["expected_net_value"].sum())
    score_as_of = scores["w1_as_of"].iloc[0] if "w1_as_of" in scores else None
    score_window_start = scores["w1_window_start"].iloc[0] if "w1_window_start" in scores else None
    score_window_end = scores["w1_window_end"].iloc[0] if "w1_window_end" in scores else None
    rolling_meta_path = os.path.join(ROLLING_MODELS, "rolling_meta.json")
    score_model = None
    if os.path.exists(rolling_meta_path):
        with open(rolling_meta_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            score_model = json.load(fh).get("selected_model")
    summary = {
        "week_start": week.date().isoformat(),
        "week_end": (week + pd.Timedelta(days=6)).date().isoformat(),
        "country": country,
        "objective": objective,
        "score_as_of": str(pd.Timestamp(score_as_of).date()) if score_as_of is not None else None,
        "score_window_start": str(pd.Timestamp(score_window_start).date()) if score_window_start is not None else None,
        "score_window_end": str(pd.Timestamp(score_window_end).date()) if score_window_end is not None else None,
        "score_model": score_model,
        "objective_label": OBJECTIVES[objective],
        "budget_usd": round(budget, 2),
        "seasonal_factor": round(float(seasonal_factor), 4),
        "seasonal_note": seasonal_note,
        "planned_contacts": int(len(df)),
        "planned_spend": round(spend, 2),
        "budget_used_pct": round(spend / budget, 4) if budget else None,
        "expected_incremental_revenue": round(inc_rev, 2),
        "expected_incremental_margin": round(inc_margin, 2),
        "expected_net_value": round(net, 2),
        "expected_roi": round(net / spend, 4) if spend else None,
        "avg_uplift": round(float(df["uplift"].mean()), 5) if len(df) else None,
        "avg_purchase_probability": round(float(df["purchase_probability"].mean()), 5) if len(df) else None,
        "avg_w1_probability": round(float(df["w1_probability"].mean()), 5) if len(df) else None,
        "offer_mix": df["offer_code"].value_counts().to_dict() if len(df) else {},
        "channel_mix": df["channel"].value_counts().to_dict() if len(df) else {},
        "tier_mix": df["cust_tier"].value_counts().to_dict() if len(df) else {},
    }
    return df, summary


def main() -> None:
    ensure_dirs()
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--week", default=None,
                        help="Planning week (default: first budget week on/after latest data date)")
    parser.add_argument("--country", default="US")
    parser.add_argument("--objective", default="incremental_revenue", choices=sorted(OBJECTIVES))
    parser.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--min-uplift", type=float, default=0.0)
    parser.add_argument("--max-contacts", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--cooldown-days", type=int, default=14)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    week = pd.Timestamp(args.week) if args.week else default_week_start()

    plan, summary = build_plan(
        week, args.country, args.budget, args.objective, args.min_uplift,
        max_contacts=args.max_contacts, cooldown_days=args.cooldown_days,
    )
    stem = f"plan_{week.date().isoformat()}_{args.country}_{args.objective}"
    plan.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_OUTPUTS, stem + ".csv"), index=False)
    with open(os.path.join(OUT_REPORTS, stem + ".json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(summary, fh, indent=2)
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    print(plan.head(10).to_string(index=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import subprocess
import sys

from shopsphere.app import approvals
from shopsphere.common import OUT_DATA, PROJECT, ROLLING_MODELS, SRC_DIR
from shopsphere.features import build_analytics, prep_contacts
from shopsphere.models import score_offers, train_offer


def _run_module(module: str, *args: str) -> None:
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["PYTHONPATH"] = SRC_DIR + os.pathsep + env.get("PYTHONPATH", "")
    subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", module, *args],
        cwd=PROJECT, env=env, check=True,
    )


def ensure_rolling_model() -> None:
    if os.environ.get("SHOPSPHERE_SKIP_ROLLING") == "1":
        print("rolling model step skipped (SHOPSPHERE_SKIP_ROLLING=1)")
        return
    meta = os.path.join(ROLLING_MODELS, "rolling_meta.json")
    live = os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "live_scores.pkl")
    retrain = os.environ.get("SHOPSPHERE_RETRAIN_ROLLING") == "1"
    if os.path.exists(meta) and os.path.exists(live) and not retrain:
        print("rolling model artifacts already present")
        return

    count = os.environ.get("SHOPSPHERE_SNAPSHOTS", "12")
    seeds = os.environ.get("SHOPSPHERE_MLP_SEEDS", "42")
    epochs = os.environ.get("SHOPSPHERE_MLP_EPOCHS", "10")
    print(f"building {count} rolling snapshots")
    _run_module("shopsphere.models.snapshot_builder", "--count", count)
    print(f"training rolling W1 model (seeds={seeds}, max epochs={epochs})")
    _run_module(
        "shopsphere.models.train_rolling",
        "--mlp-seeds", seeds, "--max-epochs", epochs,
    )


def main() -> None:
    print("=== 0/6 rolling W1 model ===")
    ensure_rolling_model()
    print("=== 1/6 contact features ===")
    prep_contacts.main()
    print("=== 2/6 offer-response model ===")
    train_offer.main()
    print("=== 3/6 candidate scoring ===")
    score_offers.main()
    print("=== 4/6 analytics ===")
    build_analytics.main()
    print("=== 5/6 approvals store ===")
    approvals.connect().close()
    print("=== 6/6 run summary ===")
    print("Pipeline complete. Run: py app.py")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ShopSphere Retention Intelligence

Integrated solution for W1, W3, W6, W9 and W10.

## Quick start

```powershell
py run_all.py
py -m streamlit run app.py
```

`run_all.py` rebuilds the rolling W1 model when needed, contact features, the
offer-response models, candidate scores, analytics tables and the approval
database. The Streamlit app reads the generated files.

## What each tab covers

| Tab | Requirement | Content |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Overview | W6 | Country/date KPIs, revenue trends, country scorecard, carrier reliability |
| Campaigns | W10 | Campaign ROAS/CPA, retention-offer lift, regional difference-in-differences |
| Seasonality | W6 | Month/year revenue index, holiday uplift, dormant-customer reactivation, YoY trends |
| Propensity | W1 | Model comparison, validation metrics, score distribution, segment summary |
| Recommendations | W3 | Weekly budgeted offer/channel plan with guardrails, seasonal demand factor and CSV download |
| Approvals | W9 | Create batches, approve/reject with reviewer and reason, audit trail, export |

## Key outputs

- `data/processed/historical_contacts.pkl`: contact-time features for 9,000 historical contacts.
- `data/processed/current_customers.pkl`: 80,000-customer snapshot with W1 scores.
- `data/processed/offer_candidate_scores.parquet`: 466,349 customer x offer x channel candidates.
- `data/processed/analytics_*.csv`: W6/W10 dashboard tables, including
  `analytics_seasonality_month.csv` and `analytics_seasonality_calendar.csv`.
- `artifacts/models/fixed|rolling|offer/`: preprocessing and model artifacts.
- `artifacts/reports/offer/offer_metrics.json`: offer-model validation metrics.
- `artifacts/reports/analytics/analytics_summary.json`: analytics row counts and date coverage.
- `data/processed/approvals.sqlite`: W9 batches, recommendations and audit log.
- `artifacts/outputs/`: downloaded plans and approved-batch exports.

## Model summary

W1 selected model: rolling Ensemble (MLP + HGB), validation ROC-AUC 0.9194,
PR-AUC 0.6230, F1 0.5967 at threshold 0.608. The model is trained on monthly
as-of snapshots and predicts purchases in the 30-day window after each snapshot.
Target-window seasonality features include target-month shares, holiday
proximity, and country/region demand indices.

Offer purchase model: Gradient Boosting, validation ROC-AUC 0.8347, PR-AUC 0.3199,
F1 0.3686 at threshold 0.603. Redemption model: ROC-AUC 0.9795, PR-AUC 0.9469.

## Seasonality

Revenue is strongly seasonal: November averages about 1.6x and December about 2.2x a normal
month (holiday average 1.9x), while January is about 0.6x. Dormant customers are more likely
to return during the Nov-Dec peak. The Seasonality tab exposes these month/year patterns, and
the W3 planner applies a same-month seasonal demand factor (clamped to 0.75x-1.35x for
stability) to expected incremental revenue. This stops a seasonal lull from being mistaken
for churn and stops a campaign being credited for demand that would have occurred anyway.

## W3 assumptions

- Incremental effect is modelled as `purchase_probability - baseline_probability`.
- Expected incentive cost is redemption-weighted: `offer_face_value * redemption_probability`.
- Default planner objective is expected incremental revenue with `minimum expected net = 0`.
- Guardrails: country weekly budget, DNC/consent filters, service-recovery routing,
  14-day contact cooldown, one contact per customer per batch.
- The planner intentionally produces a small profitable plan rather than spending the
  full budget when incremental net value would be negative.

## W9 approval workflow

1. Build a W3 plan.
2. Enter a preparer name and create an approval batch.
3. Open the Approvals tab, choose a batch, and record an approval or rejection with a
   reviewer name and reason.
4. Only approved batches can be exported. Every create/decision/export action is recorded
   in the audit log.

## Privacy

Raw `customer_id` stays inside internal feature artifacts. Plans, approval records,
exports and app displays use pseudonymous `sample_ref` values only. No customer-level
lookup is provided.

## Caveats

- The data is treated as a sample, not a census.
- Retention offers are observational, not randomised; offer lift uses an `OFF-NONE`
  comparison standardised to tier x country x channel, and intervals crossing zero mean
  no distinguishable effect.
- Campaign attribution is platform-attributed. The regional DiD is quasi-experimental.
- Redemption model performance is unusually high; treat its probabilities as a cost
  weighting aid rather than a precise forecast.

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from shopsphere.common import (
    AOV_FALLBACK, BASE_FEATURES, CAMPAIGN_TYPES, CATEGORIES, CHANNELS,
    CUSTOMER_FEATURES, DATA_DIR, DELIVERY_STATUS, DEVICE, MARGIN_FALLBACK,
    MODEL_FEATURES, OUT_DATA, PAYMENTS, ROLLING_MODELS, SHIP_SPEEDS,
    SUPPORT_CHANNELS, TICKET_CATS, TIERS, TRAFFIC, counts, ensure_dirs,
    offer_catalogue, offer_cost_series, read_budget, read_csv, resolve_as_of,
    sample_ref, shares, to01, window_bounds,
)
from shopsphere.data import asof_features as af
from shopsphere.models.scoring import RollingScorer


def days_between(as_of: pd.Series, dates: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return (as_of - pd.to_datetime(dates)).dt.days


def base_contact_frame(contacts: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    c = read_csv("customers.csv")
    c["signup_date"] = pd.to_datetime(c["signup_date"])
    c["email_open_rate_missing"] = c["email_open_rate"].isna().astype(int)
    c["has_referral"] = c["referral_code"].notna().astype(int)
    c["tier_ord"] = c["customer_tier"].map({"Bronze": 0, "Silver": 1, "Gold": 2, "Platinum": 3})
    c = c.rename(columns={
        "age": "cust_age", "country_code_clean": "cust_country", "region": "cust_region",
        "loyalty_score": "cust_loyalty", "email_open_rate": "cust_email_open",
        "discount_usage_rate": "cust_discount_rate", "avg_review_score": "cust_review",
        "customer_tier": "cust_tier", "credit_limit": "cust_credit_limit",
        "email_open_rate_missing": "cust_email_open_missing",
    })
    base = c[[
        "customer_id", "cust_age", "cust_country", "cust_region", "signup_date",
        "cust_loyalty", "cust_email_open", "cust_email_open_missing",
        "cust_discount_rate", "cust_review", "has_referral", "cust_tier", "tier_ord",
        "cust_credit_limit",
    ]].copy()

    geo = read_csv("geo_data.csv").rename(columns={
        "geo_ip_region": "cust_region", "average_income": "geo_income",
        "urban_ratio": "geo_urban", "internet_penetration": "geo_internet",
        "region_tier": "geo_tier",
    })
    base = base.merge(geo, on="cust_region", how="left")

    pref = read_csv("customer_preferences.csv")
    pref["last_updated"] = pd.to_datetime(pref["last_updated"])
    for col in ["email_opt_in_clean", "sms_opt_in_clean", "do_not_contact_clean"]:
        pref[col] = to01(pref[col])
    pref = pref.rename(columns={
        "email_opt_in_clean": "pref_email_opt", "sms_opt_in_clean": "pref_sms_opt",
        "preferred_channel": "pref_channel", "preferred_language": "pref_language",
        "do_not_contact_clean": "pref_dnc",
    })
    base = base.merge(
        pref[["customer_id", "pref_email_opt", "pref_sms_opt", "pref_channel",
              "pref_language", "pref_dnc", "last_updated"]],
        on="customer_id", how="left",
    )

    out = contacts.merge(base, on="customer_id", how="left")
    out["tenure_days"] = days_between(out["contact_date"], out["signup_date"])
    out["pref_days_since_update"] = days_between(out["contact_date"], out["last_updated"])
    out = out.drop(columns=["signup_date", "last_updated"])

    budget = read_budget().groupby("country")["retention_budget_usd"].mean()
    out["country_avg_weekly_budget"] = out["cust_country"].map(budget)

    offers = offer_catalogue()
    offers = offers.rename(columns={
        "value": "offer_value", "requires_promotable": "offer_requires_promotable",
        "counts_monthly": "offer_counts_monthly",
    })
    out = out.merge(
        offers[["offer_code", "offer_type", "offer_value", "offer_requires_promotable",
                "offer_counts_monthly", "eligible_tiers", "tier_list"]],
        on="offer_code", how="left",
    )

    def tier_match(tier, tier_list) -> int:
        if isinstance(tier_list, str):
            tier_list = [tier_list]
        if tier_list is None:
            return 0
        names = [str(t).strip() for t in tier_list]
        if any(t.lower() == "all" for t in names):
            return 1
        return int(str(tier) in names)

    out["tier_offer_match"] = [
        tier_match(t, v) for t, v in zip(out["cust_tier"], out["tier_list"])
    ]
    out["contact_channel_is_preferred"] = (
        out["channel"].astype(str) == out["pref_channel"].astype(str)
    ).astype(int)
    out = out.drop(columns=["eligible_tiers", "tier_list"])
    return out


def session_block(contacts: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    s = read_csv(
        "shopsphere_sessions_cleaned.csv",
        usecols=["customer_id", "session_timestamp", "session_duration", "pages_viewed",
                 "cart_additions", "campaign_id", "traffic_source_clean",
                 "device_type_clean", "bounce_clean", "campaign_status"],
    )
    s["event_date"] = pd.to_datetime(s["session_timestamp"]).dt.normalize()
    s["_bounce"] = to01(s["bounce_clean"])
    s["_camp"] = (s["campaign_status"] == "Has Campaign").astype(int)
    m = contacts[["contact_id", "customer_id", "contact_date"]].merge(s, on="customer_id", how="inner")
    m = m[m["event_date"] <= m["contact_date"]].copy()
    m["days_before"] = (m["contact_date"] - m["event_date"]).dt.days

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["sess_n"] = g.size()
    f["sess_days_since_last"] = g["days_before"].min()
    f["sess_tenure_days"] = g["days_before"].max()
    for d in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        f[f"sess_n_{d}d"] = m.assign(_m=m["days_before"] <= d).groupby("contact_id")["_m"].sum()
    for col, out in [("session_duration", "dur"), ("pages_viewed", "pages"),
                     ("cart_additions", "cart")]:
        f[f"sess_{out}_mean"] = g[col].mean()
        f[f"sess_{out}_max"] = g[col].max()
        f[f"sess_{out}_sum"] = g[col].sum()
    f["sess_dur_std"] = g["session_duration"].std()
    f["sess_bounce_rate"] = g["_bounce"].mean()
    f["sess_campaign_rate"] = g["_camp"].mean()
    f["sess_campaign_n"] = g["_camp"].sum()
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "traffic_source_clean", TRAFFIC, "sess_src_"))
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "device_type_clean", DEVICE, "sess_dev_"))

    camp = read_csv("marketing_campaigns.csv", usecols=["campaign_id", "campaign_type"])
    sm = m[["contact_id", "campaign_id"]].dropna(subset=["campaign_id"]).copy()
    sm["campaign_id"] = sm["campaign_id"].astype("int64")
    sm = sm.merge(camp, on="campaign_id", how="left")
    f = f.join(shares(sm, "contact_id", "campaign_type", CAMPAIGN_TYPES, "sess_camptype_"))
    return f


def transaction_block(contacts: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    t = read_csv(
        "transactions.csv",
        usecols=["transaction_id", "customer_id", "transaction_timestamp", "order_value",
                 "items_count", "payment_method", "discount_applied_clean",
                 "shipping_speed", "high_value_flag_clean"],
    )
    t["event_date"] = pd.to_datetime(t["transaction_timestamp"]).dt.normalize()
    t["_disc"] = to01(t["discount_applied_clean"])
    t["_high"] = to01(t["high_value_flag_clean"])
    m = contacts[["contact_id", "customer_id", "contact_date"]].merge(t, on="customer_id", how="inner")
    m = m[m["event_date"] <= m["contact_date"]].copy()
    m["days_before"] = (m["contact_date"] - m["event_date"]).dt.days

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["txn_n"] = g.size()
    f["txn_days_since_last"] = g["days_before"].min()
    f["txn_tenure_days"] = g["days_before"].max()
    for d in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        f[f"txn_n_{d}d"] = m.assign(_m=m["days_before"] <= d).groupby("contact_id")["_m"].sum()
        f[f"txn_spend_{d}d"] = m.assign(
            _v=np.where(m["days_before"] <= d, m["order_value"], 0.0)
        ).groupby("contact_id")["_v"].sum()
    for col, out in [("order_value", "value"), ("items_count", "items")]:
        f[f"txn_{out}_mean"] = g[col].mean()
        f[f"txn_{out}_max"] = g[col].max()
        f[f"txn_{out}_sum"] = g[col].sum()
    f["txn_value_std"] = g["order_value"].std()
    f["txn_value_median"] = g["order_value"].median()
    f["txn_discount_rate"] = g["_disc"].mean()
    f["txn_high_value_rate"] = g["_high"].mean()
    last = m.sort_values(["contact_id", "event_date"]).groupby("contact_id")
    f["txn_last_value"] = last["order_value"].last()
    f["txn_last_items"] = last["items_count"].last()
    f["txn_spend_per_day"] = f["txn_value_sum"] / f["txn_tenure_days"].replace(0, np.nan)
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "payment_method", PAYMENTS, "txn_pay_"))
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "shipping_speed", SHIP_SPEEDS, "txn_ship_"))
    return f, m


def item_block(txn_events: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    items = read_csv("transaction_items.csv")
    products = read_csv(
        "products.csv", usecols=["product_id", "category", "margin_pct", "is_promotable_clean"]
    )
    items = items.merge(products, on="product_id", how="left")
    items["line_value"] = items["quantity"] * items["unit_price"]
    items["_promo"] = to01(items["is_promotable_clean"]).fillna(0)
    m = txn_events[["contact_id", "transaction_id", "event_date", "days_before"]].merge(
        items, on="transaction_id", how="inner"
    )

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["item_lines"] = g.size()
    f["item_qty"] = g["quantity"].sum()
    f["item_list_value"] = g["line_value"].sum()
    f["item_weighted_margin"] = (
        m.assign(_w=m["line_value"] * m["margin_pct"]).groupby("contact_id")["_w"].sum()
        / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    low_margin = m.assign(
        _lm=np.where(m["margin_pct"] < 0.25, m["line_value"], 0.0)
    ).groupby("contact_id")["_lm"].sum()
    f["item_low_margin_share"] = low_margin / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)
    promo_value = m.assign(
        _pv=np.where(m["_promo"] == 1, m["line_value"], 0.0)
    ).groupby("contact_id")["_pv"].sum()
    f["item_promotable_share"] = promo_value / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)

    cat = m.groupby(["contact_id", "category"])["line_value"].sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
    cat = cat.reindex(columns=CATEGORIES, fill_value=0.0)
    cat = cat.div(cat.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)
    cat.columns = [f"item_cat_{c}" for c in cat.columns]
    return f.join(cat)


def delivery_block(txn_events: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    d = read_csv(
        "deliveries.csv",
        usecols=["transaction_id", "carrier", "ship_date", "delivered_date", "delay_days",
                 "delivery_status"],
    )
    d["ship_date"] = pd.to_datetime(d["ship_date"])
    m = txn_events[["contact_id", "transaction_id", "contact_date", "event_date"]].merge(
        d, on="transaction_id", how="inner"
    )
    m = m[m["ship_date"] <= m["contact_date"]].copy()
    m["_late"] = (m["delivery_status"] == "Delivered Late").astype(int)
    m["_lost"] = (m["delivery_status"] == "Lost").astype(int)
    m["_returned"] = (m["delivery_status"] == "Returned").astype(int)
    m["_transit"] = (m["delivery_status"] == "In Transit").astype(int)

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["del_n"] = g.size()
    f["del_carriers"] = g["carrier"].nunique()
    f["del_late_rate"] = g["_late"].mean()
    f["del_lost_rate"] = g["_lost"].mean()
    f["del_returned_rate"] = g["_returned"].mean()
    f["del_transit_rate"] = g["_transit"].mean()
    f["del_delay_mean"] = g["delay_days"].mean()
    f["del_delay_max"] = g["delay_days"].max()
    f["del_delay_sum"] = g["delay_days"].sum()
    f["del_last_status_late"] = (
        m.sort_values(["contact_id", "ship_date"]).groupby("contact_id")["_late"].last()
    )
    return f


def support_block(contacts: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    s = read_csv(
        "support_tickets.csv",
        usecols=["ticket_id", "customer_id", "created_date", "channel_clean", "category",
                 "priority", "status", "first_response_hours", "resolution_hours", "csat_score"],
    )
    s["event_date"] = pd.to_datetime(s["created_date"]).dt.normalize()
    s["_open"] = (s["status"] == "Open").astype(int)
    s["_high"] = (s["priority"] == "High").astype(int)
    s["_low_csat"] = (s["csat_score"] <= 2).astype(int)
    m = contacts[["contact_id", "customer_id", "contact_date"]].merge(s, on="customer_id", how="inner")
    m = m[m["event_date"] <= m["contact_date"]].copy()
    m["days_before"] = (m["contact_date"] - m["event_date"]).dt.days

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["sup_n"] = g.size()
    f["sup_open_n"] = g["_open"].sum()
    f["sup_high_n"] = g["_high"].sum()
    f["sup_low_csat_n"] = g["_low_csat"].sum()
    f["sup_days_since_last"] = g["days_before"].min()
    f["sup_csat_mean"] = g["csat_score"].mean()
    f["sup_fr_mean"] = g["first_response_hours"].mean()
    f["sup_fr_max"] = g["first_response_hours"].max()
    f["sup_res_mean"] = g["resolution_hours"].mean()
    f["sup_res_max"] = g["resolution_hours"].max()
    f["sup_n_90d"] = m.assign(_m=m["days_before"] <= 90).groupby("contact_id")["_m"].sum()

    complaint_cats = ["Late delivery", "Damaged or wrong item", "Lost parcel", "Refund status"]
    recent = m[(m["days_before"] <= 90) & (m["category"].isin(complaint_cats))]
    f["sup_recent_complaint"] = f.index.isin(recent["contact_id"]).astype(int)
    f = f.join(counts(m, "contact_id", "category", TICKET_CATS, "sup_cat_"))
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "channel_clean", SUPPORT_CHANNELS, "sup_ch_"))
    return f


def historical_features() -> pd.DataFrame:
    contacts = read_csv("retention_contact_history.csv")
    contacts["contact_date"] = pd.to_datetime(contacts["contact_date"])
    contacts["purchased_within_14d"] = to01(contacts["purchased_within_14d_clean"]).fillna(0).astype(int)
    contacts["redeemed"] = to01(contacts["redeemed_clean"])

    feats = base_contact_frame(contacts)
    print("  sessions")
    sess = session_block(contacts)
    print("  transactions")
    txn, txn_events = transaction_block(contacts)
    print("  items")
    items = item_block(txn_events)
    print("  deliveries")
    deliv = delivery_block(txn_events)
    print("  support")
    sup = support_block(contacts)

    feats = feats.merge(txn, left_on="contact_id", right_index=True, how="left")
    feats["expected_order_value"] = np.where(
        feats["txn_n_90d"].fillna(0) > 0,
        feats["txn_spend_90d"] / feats["txn_n_90d"].replace(0, np.nan),
        feats["txn_value_mean"],
    )
    feats["expected_order_value"] = feats["expected_order_value"].fillna(AOV_FALLBACK)
    feats["offer_cost"] = offer_cost_series(feats)

    for block in (sess, items, deliv, sup):
        feats = feats.merge(block, left_on="contact_id", right_index=True, how="left")

    feats["margin"] = feats["item_weighted_margin"].fillna(MARGIN_FALLBACK)
    feats["item_promotable_share"] = feats["item_promotable_share"].fillna(0.0)

    count_cols = [
        "sess_n", "sess_n_30d", "sess_n_90d", "sess_n_180d", "sess_n_365d",
        "sess_campaign_n", "txn_n", "txn_n_30d", "txn_n_90d", "txn_n_180d",
        "txn_n_365d", "item_lines", "item_qty", "del_n", "sup_n", "sup_open_n",
        "sup_high_n", "sup_low_csat_n", "sup_n_90d",
    ] + [f"sup_cat_{c}" for c in TICKET_CATS]
    for col in count_cols:
        if col in feats.columns:
            feats[col] = feats[col].fillna(0)
    for col in ["sup_recent_complaint"]:
        if col in feats.columns:
            feats[col] = feats[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

    for col in MODEL_FEATURES:
        if col not in feats.columns:
            feats[col] = np.nan
    feats["offer_requires_promotable"] = feats["offer_requires_promotable"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    feats["offer_counts_monthly"] = feats["offer_counts_monthly"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    feats["tier_offer_match"] = feats["tier_offer_match"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    feats["contact_channel_is_preferred"] = feats["contact_channel_is_preferred"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    return feats


def rolling_live_snapshot() -> pd.DataFrame:
    path = os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "live_scores.pkl")
    if os.path.exists(path):
        print(f"  using rolling live scores from {path}")
        return pd.read_pickle(path)

    as_of = resolve_as_of(None, DATA_DIR)
    raw = af.load_raw(DATA_DIR)
    cur = af.build_snapshot(raw, as_of, DATA_DIR, labelled=False)
    scorer = RollingScorer()
    cur["w1_probability"] = scorer.predict_proba(cur)
    cur["w1_target"] = (cur["w1_probability"] >= scorer.threshold).astype(int)
    cur["w1_as_of"] = pd.Timestamp(as_of)
    start, end = window_bounds(as_of, af.WINDOW_DAYS)
    cur["w1_window_start"] = start
    cur["w1_window_end"] = end
    return cur


def current_snapshot() -> pd.DataFrame:
    cur = rolling_live_snapshot()
    cur["sample_ref"] = sample_ref(cur["customer_id"])

    as_of = pd.Timestamp(cur["w1_as_of"].iloc[0]) if "w1_as_of" in cur else \
        resolve_as_of(None, DATA_DIR)
    r = read_csv("retention_contact_history.csv", usecols=["customer_id", "contact_date"])
    r["contact_date"] = pd.to_datetime(r["contact_date"])
    r = r[r["contact_date"] <= as_of]
    last = r.groupby("customer_id")["contact_date"].max().rename("last_contact_date")
    cur = cur.drop(columns=["last_contact_date"], errors="ignore")
    return cur.merge(last, left_on="customer_id", right_index=True, how="left")


def main() -> None:
    ensure_dirs()
    print("Building historical contact features ...")
    hist = historical_features()
    hist.to_pickle(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "historical_contacts.pkl"))

    print("Building current customer snapshot ...")
    cur = current_snapshot()
    cur.to_pickle(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "current_customers.pkl"))

    offers = offer_catalogue().drop(columns=["tier_list"])
    offers.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "offer_catalogue_clean.csv"), index=False)

    rolling_meta_path = os.path.join(ROLLING_MODELS, "rolling_meta.json")
    rolling_meta = {}
    if os.path.exists(rolling_meta_path):
        with open(rolling_meta_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            rolling_meta = json.load(fh)
    score_as_of = cur["w1_as_of"].iloc[0] if "w1_as_of" in cur else None
    score_window_start = cur["w1_window_start"].iloc[0] if "w1_window_start" in cur else None
    score_window_end = cur["w1_window_end"].iloc[0] if "w1_window_end" in cur else None
    summary = {
        "historical_contacts": int(len(hist)),
        "historical_customers": int(hist["customer_id"].nunique()),
        "historical_purchase_rate": round(float(hist["purchased_within_14d"].mean()), 5),
        "current_customers": int(len(cur)),
        "current_w1_mean": round(float(cur["w1_probability"].mean()), 5),
        "current_w1_high_share": round(float(cur["w1_target"].mean()), 5),
        "score_as_of": str(pd.Timestamp(score_as_of).date()) if score_as_of is not None else None,
        "score_window_start": str(pd.Timestamp(score_window_start).date()) if score_window_start is not None else None,
        "score_window_end": str(pd.Timestamp(score_window_end).date()) if score_window_end is not None else None,
        "w1_model": rolling_meta.get("selected_model"),
        "w1_threshold": rolling_meta.get("selected_threshold"),
        "model_features": len(MODEL_FEATURES),
        "categorical_features": [c for c in MODEL_FEATURES if c in
                                  ["cust_country", "cust_region", "cust_tier", "geo_tier",
                                   "pref_channel", "pref_language", "offer_code", "channel",
                                   "offer_type"]],
    }
    with open(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "prep_summary.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(summary, fh, indent=2)
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os

import joblib
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from shopsphere.common import (
    CHANNELS, MODEL_FEATURES, OFFER_MODELS as OUT_MODELS,
    OFFER_REPORTS as OUT_REPORTS, OUT_DATA, ensure_dirs, offer_catalogue,
    offer_cost_series, tiers_for_offer,
)

CHUNK = 10000


def channel_ok(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    ok = pd.Series(True, index=df.index)
    ok &= df["channel"].eq("email") & df["pref_email_opt"].fillna(0).astype(int).eq(1) | \
        df["channel"].ne("email")
    ok &= df["channel"].eq("sms") & df["pref_sms_opt"].fillna(0).astype(int).eq(1) | \
        df["channel"].ne("sms")
    ok &= df["pref_dnc"].fillna(0).astype(int).eq(0)
    return ok


def service_ok(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    recovery = df["sup_recent_complaint"].fillna(0).astype(int).eq(1) & \
        df["sup_open_n"].fillna(0).gt(0)
    return ~recovery | df["offer_code"].eq("OFF-SRC")


def tier_offer_lookup(offers: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for _, offer in offers.iterrows():
        for tier in tiers_for_offer(offer):
            rows.append((offer["offer_code"], tier))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["offer_code", "cust_tier"])


def candidate_frame(cur: pd.DataFrame, offers: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    cand = cur.merge(offers, how="cross")
    cand = cand[cand["offer_code"] != "OFF-NONE"].copy()
    lookup = tier_offer_lookup(offers)
    cand = cand.merge(lookup, on=["offer_code", "cust_tier"], how="inner")
    cand = cand[(cand["offer_requires_promotable"] == 0) |
                (cand["item_promotable_share"].fillna(0) > 0)].copy()
    cand = cand.merge(pd.DataFrame({"channel": CHANNELS}), how="cross")
    cand = cand[channel_ok(cand) & service_ok(cand)].copy()
    cand["tier_offer_match"] = 1
    cand["contact_channel_is_preferred"] = (
        cand["channel"].astype(str) == cand["pref_channel"].astype(str)
    ).astype(int)
    cand["offer_face_value"] = offer_cost_series(cand)
    cand["offer_cost"] = cand["offer_face_value"]
    return cand


def baseline_frame(cur: pd.DataFrame, offers: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    none_offer = offers[offers["offer_code"] == "OFF-NONE"].iloc[0]
    base = cur.copy()
    for col in ["offer_code", "offer_type", "offer_value", "eligible_tiers"]:
        base[col] = none_offer[col]
    base["offer_requires_promotable"] = int(none_offer["offer_requires_promotable"])
    base["offer_counts_monthly"] = int(none_offer["offer_counts_monthly"])
    base = base.merge(pd.DataFrame({"channel": CHANNELS}), how="cross")
    base = base[channel_ok(base)].copy()
    base["tier_offer_match"] = 1
    base["contact_channel_is_preferred"] = (
        base["channel"].astype(str) == base["pref_channel"].astype(str)
    ).astype(int)
    base["offer_face_value"] = 0.0
    base["offer_cost"] = 0.0
    return base


def main() -> None:
    ensure_dirs()
    cur = pd.read_pickle(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "current_customers.pkl"))
    offers = offer_catalogue().rename(columns={
        "value": "offer_value", "requires_promotable": "offer_requires_promotable",
        "counts_monthly": "offer_counts_monthly",
    })
    pre = joblib.load(os.path.join(OUT_MODELS, "offer_preprocessor.joblib"))
    purchase = joblib.load(os.path.join(OUT_MODELS, "purchase_model.joblib"))
    redemption = joblib.load(os.path.join(OUT_MODELS, "redemption_model.joblib"))
    with open(os.path.join(OUT_MODELS, "offer_meta.json"), encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        meta = json.load(fh)

    keep = [
        "customer_id", "sample_ref", "cust_country", "cust_region", "cust_tier",
        "pref_channel", "last_contact_date", "expected_order_value", "margin",
        "w1_probability", "w1_target", "w1_as_of", "w1_window_start", "w1_window_end",
    ]
    base_cols = list(dict.fromkeys(keep + MODEL_FEATURES + [
        "pref_email_opt", "pref_sms_opt", "pref_dnc", "sup_open_n",
        "sup_recent_complaint", "item_promotable_share",
    ]))
    cur = cur[[c for c in base_cols if c in cur.columns]].copy()

    rows = []
    for start in range(0, len(cur), CHUNK):
        chunk = cur.iloc[start:start + CHUNK].copy()
        cand = candidate_frame(chunk, offers)
        base = baseline_frame(chunk, offers)

        Xc = pre.transform(cand[MODEL_FEATURES]).astype(np.float32)
        cand["purchase_probability"] = purchase.predict_proba(Xc)[:, 1]
        cand["redemption_probability"] = redemption.predict_proba(Xc)[:, 1]
        cand["offer_cost"] = cand["offer_face_value"] * cand["redemption_probability"]

        Xb = pre.transform(base[MODEL_FEATURES]).astype(np.float32)
        base["baseline_probability"] = purchase.predict_proba(Xb)[:, 1]
        cand = cand.merge(
            base[["customer_id", "channel", "baseline_probability"]],
            on=["customer_id", "channel"], how="left",
        )
        cand["uplift"] = cand["purchase_probability"] - cand["baseline_probability"]
        cand["expected_incremental_revenue"] = cand["uplift"] * cand["expected_order_value"]
        cand["expected_incremental_margin"] = (
            cand["expected_incremental_revenue"] * cand["margin"]
        )
        cand["expected_net_value"] = cand["expected_incremental_margin"] - cand["offer_cost"]
        cand["roi"] = np.where(
            cand["offer_cost"] > 0,
            cand["expected_net_value"] / cand["offer_cost"].replace(0, np.nan),
            np.nan,
        )

        out_cols = [
            "sample_ref", "cust_country", "cust_region", "cust_tier", "channel",
            "offer_code", "offer_type", "offer_value", "purchase_probability",
            "baseline_probability", "uplift", "redemption_probability",
            "expected_order_value", "margin", "offer_face_value", "offer_cost",
            "expected_incremental_revenue", "expected_incremental_margin",
            "expected_net_value", "roi", "pref_channel", "w1_probability",
            "w1_target", "w1_as_of", "w1_window_start", "w1_window_end",
            "last_contact_date",
        ]
        rows.append(cand[out_cols].copy())
        print(f"scored {min(start + CHUNK, len(cur)):,}/{len(cur):,} customers")

    scores = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
    for col in ["purchase_probability", "baseline_probability", "uplift",
                "redemption_probability", "expected_order_value", "margin", "offer_cost",
                "offer_face_value", "expected_incremental_revenue", "expected_incremental_margin",
                "expected_net_value", "roi", "w1_probability"]:
        scores[col] = pd.to_numeric(scores[col], errors="coerce").astype("float32")
    scores["w1_target"] = scores["w1_target"].fillna(0).astype("int8")
    scores["last_contact_date"] = pd.to_datetime(scores["last_contact_date"], errors="coerce")

    path = os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "offer_candidate_scores.parquet")
    scores.to_parquet(path, index=False)
    summary = {
        "rows": int(len(scores)),
        "customers": int(scores["sample_ref"].nunique()),
        "offers": sorted(scores["offer_code"].unique().tolist()),
        "channels": sorted(scores["channel"].unique().tolist()),
        "countries": sorted(scores["cust_country"].unique().tolist()),
        "positive_uplift_share": round(float((scores["uplift"] > 0).mean()), 5),
        "positive_net_share": round(float((scores["expected_net_value"] > 0).mean()), 5),
        "selected_purchase_model": meta["selected_purchase_model"],
    }
    with open(os.path.join(OUT_REPORTS, "offer_candidate_summary.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(summary, fh, indent=2)
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

display.text:
"""Load the trained ShopSphere propensity model and score customer feature rows.

Used by the dashboard and (later) the agent so there is a single scoring API.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys

import joblib
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch

from shopsphere.common import (
    ARTIFACTS_FEATURES as FEAT, FIXED_MODELS as MODELS, FIXED_REPORTS as REPORTS,
    ROLLING_MODELS,
)
from shopsphere.models.mlp_model import MLP


class Scorer:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        with open(os.path.join(FEAT, "feature_metadata.json"), encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            self.meta = json.load(fh)
        with open(os.path.join(REPORTS, "metrics.json"), encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            self.metrics = json.load(fh)
        with open(os.path.join(MODELS, "mlp_meta.json"), encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            self.mlp_meta = json.load(fh)
        self.features = self.meta["feature_columns"]
        self.selected = self.metrics["selected_model"]
        self.threshold = float(self.metrics["selected_threshold"])
        self.pre = joblib.load(os.path.join(MODELS, "preprocessor.joblib"))
        self.hgb = joblib.load(os.path.join(MODELS, "hgb.joblib"))
        self.logreg = joblib.load(os.path.join(MODELS, "logreg.joblib"))
        self.mlps = []
        for seed in self.mlp_meta["seeds"]:
            m = MLP(self.mlp_meta["n_in"])
            m.load_state_dict(torch.load(os.path.join(MODELS, f"mlp_seed{seed}.pt"),
                                         map_location="cpu"))
            m.eval()
            self.mlps.append(m)

    def _transform(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> np.ndarray:
        return self.pre.transform(df[self.features]).astype("float32")

    def _mlp_probs(self, X: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        probs = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for m in self.mlps:
                probs.append(torch.sigmoid(m(torch.from_numpy(np.ascontiguousarray(X)))).numpy())
        return np.mean(probs, axis=0)

    def predict_proba(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> np.ndarray:
        X = self._transform(df)
        mlp = self._mlp_probs(X)
        hgb = self.hgb.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
        logreg = self.logreg.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
        table = {
            "Logistic Regression (baseline)": logreg,
            "Gradient Boosting (baseline)": hgb,
            "Deep Learning MLP (seed ensemble)": mlp,
            "Ensemble (MLP + HGB)": (mlp + hgb) / 2,
            "Ensemble (MLP + HGB + LogReg)": (mlp + hgb + logreg) / 3,
        }
        return table[self.selected]

    def predict(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> np.ndarray:
        return (self.predict_proba(df) >= self.threshold).astype(int)


class RollingScorer:
    """Scorer for the as-of/rolling W1 model in artifacts/models/rolling."""

    def __init__(self, models_dir: str | None = None) -> None:
        self.models = models_dir or ROLLING_MODELS
        with open(os.path.join(self.models, "rolling_meta.json"), encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            self.meta = json.load(fh)
        self.features = self.meta["features"]
        self.selected = self.meta["selected_model"]
        self.threshold = float(self.meta["selected_threshold"])
        self.pre = joblib.load(os.path.join(self.models, "rolling_preprocessor.joblib"))
        self.hgb = joblib.load(os.path.join(self.models, "rolling_hgb.joblib"))
        self.logreg = joblib.load(os.path.join(self.models, "rolling_logreg.joblib"))
        width = self.meta.get("final_transformed_width", self.meta["transformed_width"])
        self.mlps = []
        for seed in self.meta.get("mlp_seeds", []):
            path = os.path.join(self.models, f"rolling_mlp_seed{seed}.pt")
            if not os.path.exists(path):
                continue
            model = MLP(width)
            model.load_state_dict(torch.load(path, map_location="cpu"))
            model.eval()
            self.mlps.append(model)

    def _transform(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> np.ndarray:
        X = df[self.features].copy()
        for col in self.meta["categorical"]:
            X[col] = X[col].astype("string")
        for col in self.meta["numeric"]:
            X[col] = pd.to_numeric(X[col], errors="coerce")
        return self.pre.transform(X).astype("float32")

    def _mlp_probs(self, X: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        if not self.mlps:
            return np.full(len(X), np.nan)
        probs = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for model in self.mlps:
                probs.append(
                    torch.sigmoid(model(torch.from_numpy(np.ascontiguousarray(X)))).numpy()
                )
        return np.mean(probs, axis=0)

    def predict_proba(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> np.ndarray:
        X = self._transform(df)
        mlp = self._mlp_probs(X)
        hgb = self.hgb.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
        logreg = self.logreg.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
        table = {
            "Logistic Regression (baseline)": logreg,
            "Gradient Boosting (HGB)": hgb,
            "Deep Learning MLP (seed ensemble)": mlp,
            "Ensemble (MLP + HGB)": (mlp + hgb) / 2,
            "Ensemble (MLP + HGB + LogReg)": (mlp + hgb + logreg) / 3,
        }
        return table[self.selected]

    def predict(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> np.ndarray:
        return (self.predict_proba(df) >= self.threshold).astype(int)

# ShopSphere Architecture

## Principles

- `src/` contains all runnable Python code.
- `data/raw/` is immutable input; `data/processed/` is generated runtime data.
- `artifacts/` contains features, snapshots, models, reports, and exported files.
- Root entry points are thin wrappers that add `src` to `sys.path`.
- No hardcoded run dates in the active path; as-of dates are resolved from the
  data or passed through environment variables.

## Layout

```
run_all.py                 full pipeline entry point
app.py                     Streamlit entry point
planner.py                 weekly planner entry point
src/shopsphere/
  common.py                paths, feature lists, shared helpers
  data/
    asof_time.py           as-of resolution and window bounds
    asof_features.py       point-in-time feature builder
    build_features.py      fixed official feature builder
  features/
    prep_contacts.py       historical/current contact preparation
    build_analytics.py     W6/W10 analytics tables
  models/
    mlp_model.py           PyTorch MLP
    scoring.py             fixed and rolling scorers
    train_models.py        fixed W1 model
    snapshot_builder.py    monthly as-of snapshots
    train_rolling.py       rolling W1 train/backtest/live scoring
    train_offer.py         offer purchase and redemption models
    score_offers.py        customer x offer x channel scoring
  pipelines/
    run_all.py             end-to-end orchestration
    planner.py             weekly budgeted recommendation plan
  app/
    app.py                 Streamlit dashboard
    approvals.py           W9 approval workflow and SQLite audit log
data/raw/                  cleaned source CSVs
data/processed/            contacts, scores, analytics CSVs, approvals.sqlite
artifacts/features/        fixed feature pickles and metadata
artifacts/snapshots/       rolling snapshots and manifest
artifacts/models/          fixed/, rolling/, offer/
artifacts/reports/         fixed/, rolling/, offer/, analytics/, plans/, logs/
artifacts/outputs/         plans, submissions, approved exports
```

## Data flow

1. `snapshot_builder.py` builds monthly as-of snapshots from raw data.
2. `train_rolling.py` trains MLP, HGB, and logistic regression, tunes the
   ensemble threshold on the validation month, refits, and writes live scores.
3. `prep_contacts.py` joins live scores to current customers and historical
   contact features.
4. `train_offer.py` trains purchase/redemption models on a dynamic time split.
5. `score_offers.py` creates customer x offer x channel candidates.
6. `build_analytics.py` writes W6/W10 tables.
7. `planner.py` and `app.py` consume processed data and artifacts.

## Artifact ownership

| Path | Producer |
| --- | --- |
| `data/processed/*.pkl`, `*.parquet`, `*.csv` | prep/scoring/analytics |
| `data/processed/approvals.sqlite` | approvals |
| `artifacts/features/` | build_features |
| `artifacts/snapshots/` | snapshot_builder |
| `artifacts/models/fixed/` | train_models |
| `artifacts/models/rolling/` | train_rolling |
| `artifacts/models/offer/` | train_offer |
| `artifacts/reports/fixed/` | train_models |
| `artifacts/reports/rolling/` | train_rolling |
| `artifacts/reports/offer/` | train_offer, score_offers |
| `artifacts/reports/analytics/` | build_analytics |
| `artifacts/reports/plans/` | planner |
| `artifacts/outputs/` | planner, approvals, train_models |

47: def to01(s: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
48:     """Map booleans / TRUE-FALSE / Y-N encodings to 1/0 (NaN stays NaN)."""
49:     if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(s):
50:         return s.astype("int64")
51:     low = s.astype("string").str.strip().str.lower()
52:     return low.map({"true": 1, "false": 0, "y": 1, "n": 0, "yes": 1, "no": 0,
53:                     "1": 1, "0": 0, "t": 1, "f": 0})

56: def shares(df: pd.DataFrame, id_col: str, cat_col: str, categories: list[str], prefix: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
57:     tmp = df[[id_col, cat_col]].dropna()
58:     tab = tmp.groupby([id_col, cat_col]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
59:     tab = tab.reindex(columns=categories, fill_value=0)
60:     out = tab.div(tab.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)
61:     out.columns = [f"{prefix}{c}" for c in out.columns]
62:     return out

66:     tmp = df[[id_col, cat_col]].dropna()
67:     tab = tmp.groupby([id_col, cat_col]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
68:     tab = tab.reindex(columns=categories, fill_value=0)
69:     tab.columns = [f"{prefix}{c}" for c in tab.columns]

244: def item_features(txn: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:

247:     items = items.merge(products, on="product_id", how="left")
248:     items["line_value"] = items["quantity"] * items["unit_price"]
249:     items = items.merge(txn[["transaction_id", "customer_id", "d"]], on="transaction_id", how="left")
250:     items = items.dropna(subset=["customer_id"])
251:     items["customer_id"] = items["customer_id"].astype("int64")
252: 
253:     g = items.groupby("customer_id")
254:     f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
255:     f["item_lines"] = g.size()
256:     f["item_qty"] = g["quantity"].sum()
257:     f["item_list_value"] = g["line_value"].sum()
258:     f["item_weighted_margin"] = (

265:     f["item_low_margin_share"] = low_margin / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)

display.text:
"""
ShopSphere - customer-level feature engineering for the 30-day purchase target.

Reads the cleaned tables in data/raw and builds one row per customer using only
information up to the snapshot cutoff (2024-09-30), so the October target is
never leaked.

Outputs (artifacts/features):
    train_features.pkl   customer_id + features + target
    test_features.pkl    customer_id + features
    feature_metadata.json
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from shopsphere.common import DATA_DIR as DATA, ARTIFACTS_FEATURES as OUT

CUTOFF = pd.Timestamp("2024-09-30")

TRAFFIC = ["organic", "direct", "ads", "email", "social"]
DEVICE = ["mobile", "desktop", "tablet"]
CAMPAIGN_TYPES = ["Email", "Search", "Display", "Social", "Affiliate"]
PAYMENTS = ["credit_card", "debit_card", "paypal", "crypto"]
SHIP_SPEEDS = ["standard", "express", "overnight"]
DELIVERY_STATUS = ["Delivered", "Delivered Late", "Lost", "Returned", "In Transit"]
TICKET_CATS = [
    "Late delivery", "Damaged or wrong item", "Product question", "Refund status",
    "Lost parcel", "Payment issue", "Account access", "Promo code not working", "Cancel order",
]
RET_CHANNELS = ["email", "app_push", "sms"]


def read(name: str, **kw) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA, name), low_memory=False, **kw)


def days_since(dates: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return (CUTOFF - pd.to_datetime(dates)).dt.days


def to01(s: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """Map booleans / TRUE-FALSE / Y-N encodings to 1/0 (NaN stays NaN)."""
    if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(s):
        return s.astype("int64")
    low = s.astype("string").str.strip().str.lower()
    return low.map({"true": 1, "false": 0, "y": 1, "n": 0, "yes": 1, "no": 0,
                    "1": 1, "0": 0, "t": 1, "f": 0})


def shares(df: pd.DataFrame, id_col: str, cat_col: str, categories: list[str], prefix: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    tmp = df[[id_col, cat_col]].dropna()
    tab = tmp.groupby([id_col, cat_col]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    tab = tab.reindex(columns=categories, fill_value=0)
    out = tab.div(tab.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)
    out.columns = [f"{prefix}{c}" for c in out.columns]
    return out


def counts(df: pd.DataFrame, id_col: str, cat_col: str, categories: list[str], prefix: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    tmp = df[[id_col, cat_col]].dropna()
    tab = tmp.groupby([id_col, cat_col]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    tab = tab.reindex(columns=categories, fill_value=0)
    tab.columns = [f"{prefix}{c}" for c in tab.columns]
    return tab


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def customer_base() -> pd.DataFrame:
    c = read("customers.csv")
    c["tenure_days"] = days_since(c["signup_date"])
    c["email_open_rate_missing"] = c["email_open_rate"].isna().astype(int)
    c["has_referral"] = c["referral_code"].notna().astype(int)
    c["tier_ord"] = c["customer_tier"].map({"Bronze": 0, "Silver": 1, "Gold": 2, "Platinum": 3})
    c = c.rename(columns={
        "age": "cust_age", "country_code_clean": "cust_country", "region": "cust_region",
        "loyalty_score": "cust_loyalty", "email_open_rate": "cust_email_open",
        "discount_usage_rate": "cust_discount_rate", "avg_review_score": "cust_review",
        "customer_tier": "cust_tier", "credit_limit": "cust_credit_limit",
        "email_open_rate_missing": "cust_email_open_missing",
    })
    keep = ["customer_id", "cust_age", "cust_country", "cust_region", "tenure_days",
            "cust_loyalty", "cust_email_open", "cust_email_open_missing",
            "cust_discount_rate", "cust_review", "has_referral", "cust_tier", "tier_ord",
            "cust_credit_limit"]
    base = c[keep].copy()

    geo = read("geo_data.csv").rename(columns={
        "geo_ip_region": "cust_region", "average_income": "geo_income",
        "urban_ratio": "geo_urban", "internet_penetration": "geo_internet",
        "region_tier": "geo_tier",
    })
    base = base.merge(geo, on="cust_region", how="left")

    pref = read("customer_preferences.csv")
    pref["pref_days_since_update"] = days_since(pref["last_updated"])
    for col in ["email_opt_in_clean", "sms_opt_in_clean", "do_not_contact_clean"]:
        pref[col] = to01(pref[col])
    pref = pref.rename(columns={
        "email_opt_in_clean": "pref_email_opt", "sms_opt_in_clean": "pref_sms_opt",
        "preferred_channel": "pref_channel", "preferred_language": "pref_language",
        "do_not_contact_clean": "pref_dnc",
    })
    base = base.merge(
        pref[["customer_id", "pref_email_opt", "pref_sms_opt", "pref_channel",
              "pref_language", "pref_dnc", "pref_days_since_update"]],
        on="customer_id", how="left",
    )
    return base


def session_features() -> pd.DataFrame:
    s = read("shopsphere_sessions_cleaned.csv")
    s["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(s["session_timestamp"])
    s = s[s["ts"] <= CUTOFF].copy()
    s["_bounce"] = to01(s["bounce_clean"])
    s["_camp"] = (s["campaign_status"] == "Has Campaign").astype(int)

    g = s.groupby("customer_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["sess_n"] = g.size()
    f["sess_days_since_last"] = (CUTOFF - g["ts"].max()).dt.days
    f["sess_tenure_days"] = (CUTOFF - g["ts"].min()).dt.days
    for d in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        f[f"sess_n_{d}d"] = s.assign(_m=s["ts"] >= CUTOFF - pd.Timedelta(days=d)).groupby("customer_id")["_m"].sum()
    for col, out in [("session_duration", "dur"), ("pages_viewed", "pages"),
                     ("cart_additions", "cart")]:
        f[f"sess_{out}_mean"] = g[col].mean()
        f[f"sess_{out}_max"] = g[col].max()
        f[f"sess_{out}_sum"] = g[col].sum()
    f["sess_dur_std"] = g["session_duration"].std()
    f["sess_bounce_rate"] = g["_bounce"].mean()
    f["sess_campaign_rate"] = g["_camp"].mean()
    f["sess_campaign_n"] = g["_camp"].sum()

    f = f.join(shares(s, "customer_id", "traffic_source_clean", TRAFFIC, "sess_src_"))
    f = f.join(shares(s, "customer_id", "device_type_clean", DEVICE, "sess_dev_"))

    # Seasonality: how much of this customer's browsing happens in the target month
    # (October) and in the Nov-Dec holiday peak, across the multi-year history.
    s["_month"] = s["ts"].dt.month
    s["_is_oct"] = s["_month"].eq(10).astype(int)
    s["_is_holiday"] = s["_month"].isin([11, 12]).astype(int)
    s["_is_q4"] = s["_month"].isin([10, 11, 12]).astype(int)
    s["_year_month"] = s["ts"].dt.to_period("M")
    seas = s.groupby("customer_id").agg(
        sess_oct_n=("_is_oct", "sum"),
        sess_holiday_n=("_is_holiday", "sum"),
        sess_q4_n=("_is_q4", "sum"),
    )
    seas["sess_oct_share"] = seas["sess_oct_n"] / f["sess_n"]
    seas["sess_holiday_share"] = seas["sess_holiday_n"] / f["sess_n"]
    seas["sess_q4_share"] = seas["sess_q4_n"] / f["sess_n"]
    monthly = s.groupby(["customer_id", "_year_month"]).size().rename("n").reset_index()
    mg = monthly.groupby("customer_id")["n"]
    seas["sess_monthly_mean"] = mg.mean()
    seas["sess_monthly_max"] = mg.max()
    seas["sess_seasonal_index"] = (
        seas["sess_monthly_max"] / seas["sess_monthly_mean"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    f = f.join(seas)

    camp = read("marketing_campaigns.csv", usecols=["campaign_id", "campaign_type"])
    sm = s[["customer_id", "campaign_id"]].dropna(subset=["campaign_id"]).copy()
    sm["campaign_id"] = sm["campaign_id"].astype("int64")
    sm = sm.merge(camp, on="campaign_id", how="left")
    f = f.join(shares(sm, "customer_id", "campaign_type", CAMPAIGN_TYPES, "sess_camptype_"))
    return f


def transaction_features() -> pd.DataFrame:
    t = read("transactions.csv")
    t["d"] = pd.to_datetime(t["transaction_timestamp"])
    t = t[t["d"] <= CUTOFF].sort_values(["customer_id", "d"]).copy()
    t["_disc"] = to01(t["discount_applied_clean"])
    t["_high"] = to01(t["high_value_flag_clean"])

    g = t.groupby("customer_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["txn_n"] = g.size()
    f["txn_days_since_last"] = (CUTOFF - g["d"].max()).dt.days
    f["txn_tenure_days"] = (CUTOFF - g["d"].min()).dt.days
    for d in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        f[f"txn_n_{d}d"] = t.assign(_m=t["d"] >= CUTOFF - pd.Timedelta(days=d)).groupby("customer_id")["_m"].sum()
        f[f"txn_spend_{d}d"] = t.assign(_v=np.where(t["d"] >= CUTOFF - pd.Timedelta(days=d), t["order_value"], 0.0)).groupby("customer_id")["_v"].sum()
    for col, out in [("order_value", "value"), ("items_count", "items")]:
        f[f"txn_{out}_mean"] = g[col].mean()
        f[f"txn_{out}_max"] = g[col].max()
        f[f"txn_{out}_sum"] = g[col].sum()
    f["txn_value_std"] = g["order_value"].std()
    f["txn_value_median"] = g["order_value"].median()
    f["txn_discount_rate"] = g["_disc"].mean()
    f["txn_high_value_rate"] = g["_high"].mean()
    f["txn_last_value"] = g["order_value"].last()
    f["txn_last_items"] = g["items_count"].last()
    f["txn_spend_per_day"] = f["txn_value_sum"] / f["txn_tenure_days"].replace(0, np.nan)

    f = f.join(shares(t, "customer_id", "payment_method", PAYMENTS, "txn_pay_"))
    f = f.join(shares(t, "customer_id", "shipping_speed", SHIP_SPEEDS, "txn_ship_"))

    # Seasonality: historical October / holiday buying behaviour. The target window is
    # October 2024, so a customer's prior-October activity is a direct seasonal signal;
    # Nov-Dec affinity captures seasonal shoppers who are otherwise dormant.
    t["_month"] = t["d"].dt.month
    t["_is_oct"] = t["_month"].eq(10).astype(int)
    t["_is_holiday"] = t["_month"].isin([11, 12]).astype(int)
    t["_is_q4"] = t["_month"].isin([10, 11, 12]).astype(int)
    t["_year_month"] = t["d"].dt.to_period("M")
    seas = t.groupby("customer_id").agg(
        txn_oct_n=("_is_oct", "sum"),
        txn_holiday_n=("_is_holiday", "sum"),
        txn_q4_n=("_is_q4", "sum"),
    )
    seas["txn_oct_share"] = seas["txn_oct_n"] / f["txn_n"]
    seas["txn_holiday_share"] = seas["txn_holiday_n"] / f["txn_n"]
    seas["txn_q4_share"] = seas["txn_q4_n"] / f["txn_n"]
    seas["txn_oct_active"] = (seas["txn_oct_n"] > 0).astype(int)
    seas["txn_holiday_active"] = (seas["txn_holiday_n"] > 0).astype(int)
    monthly = t.groupby(["customer_id", "_year_month"]).size().rename("n").reset_index()
    mg = monthly.groupby("customer_id")["n"]
    seas["txn_monthly_mean"] = mg.mean()
    seas["txn_monthly_max"] = mg.max()
    seas["txn_monthly_std"] = mg.std()
    seas["txn_seasonal_index"] = (
        seas["txn_monthly_max"] / seas["txn_monthly_mean"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    seas["txn_month_cv"] = (
        seas["txn_monthly_std"] / seas["txn_monthly_mean"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    last_oct = t[t["_is_oct"] == 1].groupby("customer_id")["d"].max()
    seas["txn_days_since_last_oct"] = (CUTOFF - last_oct).dt.days
    f = f.join(seas)
    f["txn_dormant_holiday_affinity"] = (
        (f["txn_days_since_last"] > 180).astype(int) * f["txn_holiday_share"]
    )
    return f, t


def item_features(txn: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    items = read("transaction_items.csv")
    products = read("products.csv", usecols=["product_id", "category", "margin_pct"])
    items = items.merge(products, on="product_id", how="left")
    items["line_value"] = items["quantity"] * items["unit_price"]
    items = items.merge(txn[["transaction_id", "customer_id", "d"]], on="transaction_id", how="left")
    items = items.dropna(subset=["customer_id"])
    items["customer_id"] = items["customer_id"].astype("int64")

    g = items.groupby("customer_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["item_lines"] = g.size()
    f["item_qty"] = g["quantity"].sum()
    f["item_list_value"] = g["line_value"].sum()
    f["item_weighted_margin"] = (
        items.assign(_w=items["line_value"] * items["margin_pct"]).groupby("customer_id")["_w"].sum()
        / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    low_margin = items.assign(
        _lm=np.where(items["margin_pct"] < 0.25, items["line_value"], 0.0)
    ).groupby("customer_id")["_lm"].sum()
    f["item_low_margin_share"] = low_margin / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)

    cat = items.groupby(["customer_id", "category"])["line_value"].sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
    cat = cat.div(cat.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)
    cat.columns = [f"item_cat_{c}" for c in cat.columns]
    f = f.join(cat)
    return f


def delivery_features(txn: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    d = read("deliveries.csv")
    d = d.merge(txn[["transaction_id", "customer_id", "d"]].rename(columns={"d": "txn_d"}),
                on="transaction_id", how="left")
    d = d.dropna(subset=["customer_id"])
    d["customer_id"] = d["customer_id"].astype("int64")
    d["_late"] = (d["delivery_status"] == "Delivered Late").astype(int)
    d["_lost"] = (d["delivery_status"] == "Lost").astype(int)
    d["_returned"] = (d["delivery_status"] == "Returned").astype(int)
    d["_transit"] = (d["delivery_status"] == "In Transit").astype(int)

    g = d.groupby("customer_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["del_n"] = g.size()
    f["del_carriers"] = g["carrier"].nunique()
    f["del_late_rate"] = g["_late"].mean()
    f["del_lost_rate"] = g["_lost"].mean()
    f["del_returned_rate"] = g["_returned"].mean()
    f["del_transit_rate"] = g["_transit"].mean()
    f["del_delay_mean"] = g["delay_days"].mean()
    f["del_delay_max"] = g["delay_days"].max()
    f["del_delay_sum"] = g["delay_days"].sum()
    f["del_last_status_late"] = (
        d.sort_values(["customer_id", "txn_d"]).groupby("customer_id")["_late"].last()
    )
    return f


def support_features() -> pd.DataFrame:
    s = read("support_tickets.csv")
    s["d"] = pd.to_datetime(s["created_date"])
    s = s[s["d"] <= CUTOFF].copy()
    s["_open"] = (s["status"] == "Open").astype(int)
    s["_high"] = (s["priority"] == "High").astype(int)
    s["_low_csat"] = (s["csat_score"] <= 2).astype(int)

    g = s.groupby("customer_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["sup_n"] = g.size()
    f["sup_open_n"] = g["_open"].sum()
    f["sup_high_n"] = g["_high"].sum()
    f["sup_low_csat_n"] = g["_low_csat"].sum()
    f["sup_days_since_last"] = (CUTOFF - g["d"].max()).dt.days
    f["sup_csat_mean"] = g["csat_score"].mean()
    f["sup_fr_mean"] = g["first_response_hours"].mean()
    f["sup_fr_max"] = g["first_response_hours"].max()
    f["sup_res_mean"] = g["resolution_hours"].mean()
    f["sup_res_max"] = g["resolution_hours"].max()
    f["sup_n_90d"] = s.assign(_m=s["d"] >= CUTOFF - pd.Timedelta(days=90)).groupby("customer_id")["_m"].sum()

    f = f.join(counts(s, "customer_id", "category", TICKET_CATS, "sup_cat_"))
    f = f.join(shares(s, "customer_id", "channel_clean", ["Live chat", "Email", "WhatsApp", "Phone"], "sup_ch_"))

    complaint_cats = ["Late delivery", "Damaged or wrong item", "Lost parcel", "Refund status"]
    recent = s[(s["d"] >= CUTOFF - pd.Timedelta(days=90)) & (s["category"].isin(complaint_cats))]
    f["sup_recent_complaint"] = f.index.isin(recent["customer_id"]).astype(int)
    return f


def retention_features() -> pd.DataFrame:
    r = read("retention_contact_history.csv")
    r["d"] = pd.to_datetime(r["contact_date"])
    r = r[r["d"] <= CUTOFF].copy()
    r["_redeemed"] = to01(r["redeemed_clean"])
    r["_p14"] = to01(r["purchased_within_14d_clean"])
    r["_no_offer"] = (r["offer_code"] == "OFF-NONE").astype(int)
    r["_v20"] = (r["offer_code"] == "OFF-V20").astype(int)

    g = r.groupby("customer_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["ret_n"] = g.size()
    f["ret_redeemed_n"] = g["_redeemed"].sum()
    f["ret_redeem_rate"] = g["_redeemed"].mean()
    f["ret_purch14_rate"] = g["_p14"].mean()
    f["ret_no_offer_n"] = g["_no_offer"].sum()
    f["ret_v20_n"] = g["_v20"].sum()
    f["ret_days_since_last"] = (CUTOFF - g["d"].max()).dt.days
    f = f.join(shares(r, "customer_id", "channel", RET_CHANNELS, "ret_ch_"))
    return f


def region_marketing_features() -> pd.DataFrame:
    camp = read("marketing_campaigns.csv")
    perf = read("campaign_daily_performance.csv")
    agg = perf.groupby("campaign_id").agg(
        spend=("spend", "sum"), revenue=("attributed_revenue", "sum"),
        orders=("attributed_orders", "sum"), clicks=("clicks", "sum"),
        impressions=("impressions", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()
    camp = camp.merge(agg, on="campaign_id", how="left")
    reg = camp.groupby("region_target").agg(
        reg_spend=("spend", "sum"), reg_revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
        reg_orders=("orders", "sum"), reg_clicks=("clicks", "sum"),
        reg_impressions=("impressions", "sum"), reg_campaigns=("campaign_id", "count"),
        reg_budget_mean=("campaign_budget", "mean"),
    )
    reg["reg_roas"] = reg["reg_revenue"] / reg["reg_spend"].replace(0, np.nan)
    reg["reg_ctr"] = reg["reg_clicks"] / reg["reg_impressions"].replace(0, np.nan)

    perf["date"] = pd.to_datetime(perf["date"])
    recent = perf[perf["date"] >= CUTOFF - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
    recent = recent.merge(camp[["campaign_id", "region_target"]], on="campaign_id", how="left")
    reg_recent = recent.groupby("region_target")["spend"].sum().rename("reg_spend_90d")
    reg = reg.join(reg_recent)
    reg.index.name = "cust_region"
    return reg


def country_budget() -> pd.Series:
    rb = read("retention_budget_2024Q4.csv")
    return rb.groupby("country")["retention_budget_usd"].mean().rename("country_avg_weekly_budget")


def main() -> None:
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    print("Building customer base ...")
    base = customer_base()

    print("Sessions ...")
    sess = session_features()
    print("Transactions ...")
    txn, txn_raw = transaction_features()
    print("Items ...")
    items = item_features(txn_raw)
    print("Deliveries ...")
    deliv = delivery_features(txn_raw)
    print("Support ...")
    sup = support_features()
    print("Retention contacts ...")
    ret = retention_features()
    print("Region marketing ...")
    reg = region_marketing_features()
    print("Country budget ...")
    budget = country_budget()

    feats = base.copy()
    for block in (sess, txn, items, deliv, sup, ret):
        feats = feats.merge(block, left_on="customer_id", right_index=True, how="left")
    feats = feats.merge(reg, left_on="cust_region", right_index=True, how="left")
    feats = feats.merge(budget, left_on="cust_country", right_index=True, how="left")

    count_prefixes = ("sess_n", "txn_n", "item_lines", "item_qty", "del_n", "sup_n", "ret_n",
                      "ret_redeemed_n", "ret_no_offer_n", "ret_v20_n")
    for col in feats.columns:
        if col.startswith(count_prefixes):
            feats[col] = feats[col].fillna(0)

    train_ids = read("train.csv")
    test_ids = read("test.csv")
    train = train_ids.merge(feats, on="customer_id", how="left")
    test = test_ids.merge(feats, on="customer_id", how="left")
    assert len(train) == len(train_ids) and len(test) == len(test_ids)

    feature_cols = [c for c in feats.columns if c != "customer_id"]
    cat_cols = [c for c in ["cust_country", "cust_region", "cust_tier", "geo_tier",
                            "pref_channel", "pref_language"] if c in feature_cols]
    num_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c not in cat_cols]

    train.to_pickle(os.path.join(OUT, "train_features.pkl"))
    test.to_pickle(os.path.join(OUT, "test_features.pkl"))
    meta = {
        "cutoff": str(CUTOFF.date()),
        "n_features": len(feature_cols),
        "categorical": cat_cols,
        "numeric": num_cols,
        "train_rows": int(len(train)),
        "test_rows": int(len(test)),
        "positive_rate": float(train["target"].mean()),
        "feature_columns": feature_cols,
    }
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, "feature_metadata.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(meta, fh, indent=2)

    print(f"Train {train.shape}  Test {test.shape}  features={len(feature_cols)}")
    print(f"Categorical: {cat_cols}")
    print(f"Numeric: {len(num_cols)}")
    print("Saved features to", OUT)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
